[[Surface Marshal|Marshall]] '''VeNiste''' was the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Army Sector Commander|Sector Commander]] for the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]. VeNiste ordered that [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] from the [[Valor (Imperial-class)|''Valor'']] assigned to [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime's]] surface were under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anderton Kloff]].
